title: ICreator
description: the mod adds oddities from which you can craft tools and weapons
body:
The mod adds kalu ore, which is used to craft singularities, and from them, tools.

The mod will be continuously developed.

The mod is in beta. I recommend playing with the JEI mod.
# Version 0.1
- 3 singularities (wood, Z, kalu)
- kalu shard
- kalu ore (located at a depth of 60-100)
- matter
- matter upgrade
- matter
- soul
*all these items are only used to craft tools
- new axe (breaks wood in one shot)
- new weapon/pickaxe (digs twice as fast as a netherite pickaxe)
- szit
